meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 OpenClaw 配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw configuration to NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

howto.what: 引导你把现有 OpenClaw 安装迁移到 NanoClaw v2：先扫描并总结旧配置，再逐项讨论身份、频道凭据、定时任务等如何搬到新系统，并在应用前展示改动。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from openclaw”“openclaw migration”“import from openclaw”时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
say.note: Claude 会先运行发现脚本，然后和你逐项确认。

say.text: 从 OpenClaw 导入我的身份、频道和定时任务
say.note: 它会读取旧配置并讨论哪些该迁移、放哪里。

say.text: 迁移我的 OpenClaw 群组和记忆文件
say.note: 会询问共享还是分开，再决定文件位置。

howto.what_en: Guides you through migrating an existing OpenClaw installation to NanoClaw v2: it scans and summarizes the old setup, then walks through moving identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, showing proposed changes before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", or "import from openclaw".

say_en.text: Help me migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2
say_en.note: Claude will run discovery and summarize the old install.

say_en.text: Import my identity, channels, and scheduled tasks from OpenClaw
say_en.note: It will read the config and discuss what to bring over.

say_en.text: Migrate my OpenClaw groups and memory files
say_en.note: It will ask shared vs separate, then decide placement.
